system:
You are given the set of processes running on a Linux desktop computer. Say what the machine is primarily being used for right now.

Answer exactly one mode from this menu:
- browsing: web browsing as the main activity
- office: documents, spreadsheets, presentations
- mail: reading and writing email
- dev: writing code in an editor/IDE
- photo: photo editing
- meeting: a live video call
- gaming: playing a game in the foreground
- media: media playback (video, music)
- video-edit: interactive video editing
- compile: building software
- ml-train: a machine-learning training run
- render: an offline 3D/graphics render
- transcode: batch media conversion
- indexing: file indexing / crawling
- backup: a backup job
- idle: no human present; maintenance only

Also answer background_wanted, a boolean: is the sustained background work something the user asked for? true for work the user deliberately initiated or is waiting on (a download, a kicked-off training run, a render); false for work nobody asked for right now (a scheduled scan, an indexer's rescan). Convention: when a segment has no sustained background work at all, background_wanted is true.

Reply with JSON only.
